court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Ghazipur - Matrimonial Case No. 120/2018
case_name: Vinod Kumar Singh vs Poonam Chauhan
facts_of_case: The respondent wife left the company of the appellant husband voluntarily and the husband is unemployed. The wife filed an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, seeking interim maintenance and litigation expenses.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish a prima facie case for interim maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Having heard learned counsel for the appellant and perused the impugned order as well as other material brought on record, we do not find that the impugned order suffers from any error, illegality or legal infirmity requiring any interference by this Court.

legal_principles.principle: The award of interim maintenance cannot be termed arbitrary or excessive.
legal_principles.held: Award of Rs. 3,000/- per month as interim maintenance by no stretch of imagination can be termed arbitrary or excessive.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order directing the husband to pay Rs. 3,000/- per month as interim maintenance and Rs. 10,000/- towards litigation expenses was upheld. The court also directed the Principal Judge, Family Court, Ghazipur to decide the matrimonial case expeditiously.
